question: Does this type hold an index, id, count, extent, length, offset or bound describing a program in an integer narrower than 64 bits?

fine.not_control_plane: It has no such field: its integers are data — `f32` values, `u32` pixels, ISA-defined encoding fields such as immediates, displacements or register numbers — or it has no integer fields.
fine.sixty_four_bit: Every control-plane index, id, count, extent or bound is 64 bits wide.
fine.measured_exception: A narrower control-plane field whose own doc cites a profiler measurement justifying it.

violations.narrow_control_plane: An id, index, count, extent, length, offset or bound describing a program (expression or value ids, fold or loop ends, binder slots, class ids, arena indices) is `u8`/`u16`/`u32`/`i32` without a measured justification in its doc.

guidance: Name the field and what program quantity it holds.
